oc-sp-orchestrator.description: Coordinates the complete oc-sp multi-unit pipeline.

oc-sp-intent-classifier.description: Classifies requests into independent bug and feature units.

oc-sp-debugger.description: Investigates bugs and produces confirmed root-cause analyses.

oc-sp-implementation-controller.description: Controls plan execution, integration barriers, and verification.

oc-sp-implementer.description: Implements one exclusively owned RED or GREEN file task.

oc-sp-fixer.description: Repairs one failed file task or confirmed review finding.

oc-sp-wave-reviewer.description: Performs an independent read-only review of one implementation wave.

oc-sp-final-reviewer.description: Performs the independent read-only whole-change review.

oc-sp-explorer.description: Gathers codebase evidence without modifying files.
